comment: Replay-semantics surface pinned by scripts/verify-hydration-semantics.py. These functions re-author the entity/relation deltas persisted for historical changes during Git admission, so editing one changes what a repository's past is said to contain the next time that repository is admitted. A digest mismatch is not a failure to fix by regenerating: decide first whether replay semantics changed, and if so bump HYDRATION_SEMANTICS_VERSION and hydration_semantics_version together. Bumping the version records the decision and every surface now discloses it: kin_core::hydration_semantics persists the version into a store at creation, compares the record when the store is read, and admitting a native transfer pack preserves that record only when the transported authoring version matches; absent or mismatched provenance discards it. Bumping marks every store an earlier build admitted as behind; it re-derives nothing by itself. `kin upgrade` re-derives the state such a store serves through rederive_tree_semantics, records each head's transition as a new change, and leaves the history before it as that history's own build authored it.

guarded.reason: The whole-map form of the parent-first replay, kept for callers that already hold a few trees: it checks the tree map against the change list and feeds the fold one change at a time. The per-change replay itself is enrich_historical_change.

Drives the per-change replay for both the whole-map derivation and the streaming fold a conversion uses: it decides the baseline each change is diffed from, derives the tree's state against every parent, diffs entities and relations, and releases a parent state after its last child. Its output is the exact EntityDelta/RelationDelta payload persisted for every historical change.

Turns one exact resolved tree plus CAS bodies into the entity/relation state a change is diffed from and to. Its classification, parse, and cross-file linking order decide what the past is said to contain.

Decides which cross-repo destinations a tree binds an external target for, and derives every field of that target from the importers it collects. Its output is persisted entity state, so a change here restates what a repository's past says about the symbols it reaches through another repository.

Authors the exact persisted shape of an external target: its kind, name, visibility, role, and the absence of a file origin, span, and signature. Every cross-repo reference in replayed history terminates on one of these.

Derives the persisted fingerprint of an external target. It is the only field distinguishing two targets that share a symbol name, so consumers read it as their identity and changing it repartitions them.
Chooses the persisted language of an external target from every importing language. A different choice restates the target, so history would record a modification to a node no commit touched.
Carries entity identity across changes. Whether an entity is recognized as the same one decides whether history records a modification or an unrelated add and remove pair.

The store upgrade's derivation: it re-runs the replay's state derivation for one head tree, repeating it over its own output until entity identities settle. Its output is the entity and relation state `kin upgrade` records as a head's checkpoint change, and the state the re-derivation verifier compares a committed graph against before it starts a binding-history lineage.
Offers a store's held entities to the replay as the parent entities of each file, which decides which declarations keep their identity, lineage and creating change across an upgrade.
Derives the deterministic identity an entity keeps across replayed history. Changing the inputs to this digest renames every historical entity.
Emits the entity deltas persisted for a change. Its equivalence rule decides whether a change is recorded as touching an entity at all.
Emits the relation deltas persisted for a change, and so authors the historical edge set every trace and cross-reference over the past reads.
Authors streamed historical changes by assigning derived entity and relation deltas, remapping ordered parents and recomputing each change identity before appending it to the immutable import spool.
Writes the derived deltas onto the imported changes and recomputes their identities. This is the step that makes replayed semantics the persisted historical record.

Builds the parent-first change sequence replay consumes, walking under frontier retention so a tree is held only while a later commit still resolves against it. Its ordering and tree selection decide the baseline every historical delta is computed against.

Assigns the stable artifact identities trees and entities are keyed by across the imported history, now from the leaves that differ between a commit's tree and its first parent's rather than from the whole tree, under the rule assign_artifact_identities applied. Reassignment here silently repoints every historical file.
Writes the exact source blob digest consumed by span coherence checks in both ingestion conversions; changing this field changes freshly derived historical entity payloads.
Confines an imported occurrence to its declared module during batch history replay; a pinned miss must not acquire an unrelated same-name target.
Authors one historical file's cross-file relations, including source-owner selection, exact import resolution and guarded imported receiver dispatch.

Decides whether a relation that matched a same-file entity stops there or is also handed to same-named entities in other files as name-only candidates, and at what confidence the local entity is linked, so it decides which edges replay authors for every same-file match.

Widens a C++ definition's minimum arity by its same-named declarations before the same-file tier judges a call against it, so it decides whether replay authors a local edge as parser-certain or as a candidate.

Decides which same-file matches carry an import of the name they call. During replay such a call links its local match as a candidate rather than a fact and goes on to the import tiers, which resolve the imported binding.
Decides which Go calls name their callee through an imported package. The same-file tier skips them during replay, so a same-named function in the calling file is never linked as their callee.

Decides which entities are declarations whose bodies live elsewhere. The same-file tier hands a declaration's calls on and the name tiers prefer a definition over it, so it decides which edges replay authors.
Reads the C/C++ arity bounds every arity decision in replay linking rests on.
Parses the parameter list the arity bounds come from, so a change here moves which overload and which same-file candidate replay links.
Decides whether a callee's arity bounds admit a call's argument count, the test every arity-pruned tier and the same-file settle decision apply during replay.
Decides which inferred imported crossings become persisted external target entities during historical replay; token, source-site and identity validation are semantic evidence.
Authors the persisted relation identity and evidence of imported external crossings, including exact-site lazy-getter provenance.
Validates the bounded imported-receiver shape that may author an inferred external crossing in history.
Attaches imported receiver provenance to exact parsed call occurrences that historical replay consumes; unsupported or contradictory bindings must stay unresolved.
Builds the conservative may-alias set used to withdraw imported getter provenance after local alias mutations; changing it changes replayed relations.
Vetoes imported getter provenance when supported owner or alias writes contradict the receiver; false acceptance would author an unsupported historical crossing.
Binds reserved parser controls to exact source entity digests and spans before named-import evidence can affect replay.
Requires the exact lexical site and declared import binding before new named-import resolution.
Follows bounded source-bound Python reexports and independently justified same-file Rust self imports without a global-name fallback.
Refuses competing modules/packages/stubs and requires explicit parent package body witnesses.
Authors per-occurrence named-import provenance without changing call-shape certificates.
Shared writer of the identical source-bound named-import occurrence fields used by linking and exact lifecycle reproduction.
Refuses duplicate source slices instead of allowing input order to establish witness authority.
Binds selected-tree Rust authority to the exact current entity universe before historical linking.
Supplies shared selected-tree Rust authority to every batch-linked historical source.
Reconstructs selected historical semantics and resolves Cargo roots only against that exact selected tree and its CAS.
Root Rust named-import occurrence custody excludes nested uses and supports inline module names without inventing module authority.
Imported Rust callable sites cannot bypass selected project proof through same-file or generic name tiers.
Selects the Rust file module that owns historical import edges independently of entity identity order.
Binds each fresh parser occurrence to its original resolution tier before logical-edge aggregation during replay.
Amends and rebinds only fresh source occurrences before aggregation of historical dispatch edges.
Canonicalizes original occurrence multiplicity and span-free authority records without counting metadata as calls.
Binds Go methods to the unique receiver type in the admitted package and withholds ambiguous ownership during historical relation derivation.
Maintains the live and restored-checkpoint authoring arm with the same admitted owner selection and occurrence authority as batch derivation.

guarded_files.reason: Authors exact admitted Cargo/module authority, semantic identity binding, visibility-aware named resolution and integrity versus unsupported observations; its method bodies change historical relations.
Discovers Cargo target roots and workspace-edition membership from the complete selected tree; changes alter which crate contexts can author historical bindings.
Extracts exhaustive supported module/import/declaration facts from exact Rust bodies; refusal and visibility rules bound historical named-import authority.
Authors and validates durable per-occurrence resolution bound to original evidence, logical edge identity and endpoints, including deterministic canonical merge semantics.

same_epoch_changes.reason: The previously added certificate wrapper, proof retirement helper and tests do not change historical replay. The retirement helper is used only by the daemon's LSP union; existing replay functions are unchanged. Version 31 is independently required by the Python workspace-scope upgrade. The later move of the proof record, its evidence digest and its validation into kin_model::parser_occurrence, so repository authority can recognize source-sealed parser withdrawals, keeps the same rules and field checks; a test pins the shared confidence tiers to the resolution ladder, and replay output is unchanged.
